# Visual Studio Code Interface Description

## Window Header and Title Bar
- **Application Name**: Visual Studio Code
- **Window Title**: Untitled-2 - Visual Studio Code
- **System Information Display**: "Oct 22 21:58" in the center of the title bar
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right corner of the screen, including volume, network, and power icons
- **Application Launcher**: "Activities" button on the top-left corner

## Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help

## Status Bar
- **Restricted Mode Notification**: "Restricted Mode is intended for safe code browsing. Trust this window to enable all features." with "Manage" and "Learn More" links
- **Editor Status Indicators**:
  - Line and Column: "Ln 1, Col 1"
  - Workspace Spaces: "Spaces: 4"
  - Encoding: "UTF-8"
  - Line Ending: "LF"
  - File Type: "Plain Text"
  - Error/Warning Count: "0" for both errors and warnings
- **Bottom Left Icons**: 
  - VS Code icon
  - Restricted Mode icon
  - Notification bell icon

## Sidebar (Activity Bar)
- **Icons (from top to bottom)**:
  - **File Explorer**: Icon with a number "1" badge
  - **Search**: Magnifying glass icon
  - **Source Control**: Branch icon
  - **Debug**: Bug icon
  - **Extensions**: Grid icon
  - **Terminal**: Terminal icon
  - **Settings**: Gear icon with a number "1" badge
  - **User Profile**: Person icon
  - **Grid Icon**: App launcher grid icon

## Editor Area
- **Tab Bar**:
  - "news_template" tab with a dot indicator
  - "Untitled-1" tab
  - "Untitled-2" tab with a close button (X)
- **Editor Content**:
  - Line 1: "Select a language, or fill with template, or open a different file"
  - Line 2: "Start typing to dismiss or don't show this again."
- **New File Dialog**:
  - Title: "New File..."
  - Input Field: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..."
  - Options:
    - "Text File" with "Built-In" label and "Ctrl + N" shortcut
    - "Jupyter Notebook" with ".ipynb Support" label and "Notebook" label
  - Additional Icons: "File" and "Gear" icons next to the "Text File" option

## Bottom Right Corner
- **Editor Status Indicators**:
  - Line and Column: "Ln 1, Col 1"
  - Workspace Spaces: "Spaces: 4"
  - Encoding: "UTF-8"
  - Line Ending: "LF"
  - File Type: "Plain Text"
  - Error/Warning Count: "0" for both errors and warnings

## System Tray
- **Icons**:
  - Volume control
  - Network status
  - Power button

## Desktop Environment
- **Application Launcher**: "Activities" button on the top-left corner
- **Desktop Icons**: Various application icons on the left sidebar, including:
  - Google Chrome
